{{Top|leg}}
'''Super-conducting filaments''' were weapon components integral to the function of [[Pulse rifle/Legends|pulse rifles]]. The filaments regulated the hundreds of discharges into a single, coherent beam. The filaments had short lifespans, and could explode if overused. To counter this, the weapons had [[overload circuit]]s designed to shut the weapon down in emergencies.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
